item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 13/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. An intense replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early next week. The weather will become cool appreciably and windy with one or two light rain patches over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Fung-wong will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands and transform into an extratropical cyclone gradually today.
